what_this_is: An append-only Phase-8 provenance layer over the frozen Phase-7 verification tooling registry. It adds the completed Phase-7 validator and the new Phase-8 validator without changing a single byte of its parent.
why_it_exists: artifacts/phase7_pretest_freeze.json hashes the Phase-7 registry as frozen scientific evidence, and validate_phase7.py re-hashes it. Appending to the parent would therefore invalidate historical frozen evidence. The human-approved resolution preserves the parent and records Phase-8 tooling here instead.
